fact: The Data Protection Authority issued an official notice and said it had begun accepting registration applications from controllers and processors, so it was acting by 2 June 2026.

fact: Somalia inaugurated its Data Protection Authority on 24 February 2024, following the Data Protection Law No. 005 of 2023.

fact: Article 6 establishes the Data Protection Authority as an independent agency, constituted on adoption and promulgation of the law and appointment of a General Manager (proposed by the Minister, confirmed by the Cabinet, appointed by the President, Article 13), with a Board of up to nine members to be appointed within two years of the law coming into force (Article 8); the document names no appointee, and the published date of 2023-03-22 is used.

The Somalia Data Protection Authority's own service page, dated 2 June 2026, says organisations processing personal data must register with the Authority under Article 10 of Data Protection Act No. 005 (2023), and it lists the registration forms it issues, showing a body named in law and operating.

The Somalia Data Protection Authority issued Version 1.0 of its Registration Guidelines in January 2026 under Law No. 005 of 2023, setting fees, a 30-day approval timeline and mandatory registration, showing a body named in law and operating.
